donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE CAUSAL COMPILER
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Instead of programming machines, program **cause-and-effect chains**. Give it an end state and it discovers the minimum chain of interventions that would make that state emerge across physical, biological, economic, and computational systems. Programming graduates from `instructions → output` to **`desired reality → causal architecture → reality`**.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE MECHANISM TELESCOPE
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Current science sees phenomena and tries to infer mechanisms. This system decomposes every observed process into universal mechanism fragments and searches for the hidden machinery connecting them. Eventually humanity might possess a **periodic table of mechanisms**.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE REPRESENTATION SINGULARITY
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Many hard problems are hard because we encode them badly. This system searches representations themselves until impossible-looking problems become trivial. Instead of faster algorithms, you get **new ways reality can be represented**.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE OBSERVABILITY ENGINE
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Some phenomena may remain mysterious simply because the variables that matter cannot be observed. This system searches for ways to convert hidden state into measurable state. Its product is not knowledge, but **making previously unknowable things knowable**.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE ANOMALY CIVILIZATION
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Build an entire scientific institution around anomalies rather than established disciplines. Every unexplained residual, failed replication, strange outlier, contradictory experiment, and “impossible” measurement becomes a first-class research target. Revolutions often begin in the leftovers.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE THOUGHT INTERFEROMETER
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Run radically independent reasoning systems and examine their disagreement patterns rather than averaging outputs. The interference pattern reveals hidden assumptions, just as physical interferometers expose otherwise invisible structure.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE IDEA IMMUNE SYSTEM
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Revolutionary systems need protection against seductive nonsense. Every major idea faces adversarial falsification, alternative explanations, independent replication, economic reality, and physical constraints before receiving resources.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE ERROR ECONOMY
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Reward people and systems for finding important errors before those errors become expensive. Error discovery becomes economically valuable rather than socially embarrassing.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE PREDICTION ACCOUNTING SYSTEM
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Every consequential belief gets a timestamped prediction and later reconciliation against reality. Individuals, models, institutions, and scientific theories acquire calibration ledgers.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE KNOWLEDGE PACKET
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Define a primitive capable of carrying a claim plus evidence, provenance, assumptions, uncertainty, dependencies, applicability, falsifiers, and update history.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE MISSING-MARKET DETECTOR
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Find latent supply and demand that cannot meet because trust, pricing, measurement, transaction costs, or rights are unresolved.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE OUTCOME ECONOMY
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Shift economic organization away from paying mainly for activity or access toward verified beneficial outcomes where measurement permits.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE PROOF-OF-VALUE PRIMITIVE
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Develop a standard way of binding an intervention to verifiable evidence of what value it actually created.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE REALITY RUNTIME
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Continuously observe whether a compiled intervention behaves as predicted and halt or adapt when reality diverges.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE NEW MARKET CLASS GENERATOR
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Invent exchange mechanisms for things currently impossible to price, verify, transfer, or own.

donorBodiesHydrated.title: THE POSSIBILITY ARBITRAGE ENGINE
donorBodiesHydrated.literalBodyMarkdown: Detect places where two distant fields imply a capability neither field has recognized.
